title: Policegiri
desc: Tired of the rampant corruption fueled by Nagori Subramaniam, DCP Rudra takes a defiant stand. He launches a one-man crusade to take down the crime lord and dismantle his criminal syndicate.

title: Baby John
desc: An indomitable policeman goes to greater lengths and leads a double life in order to protect his daughter from the criminal underworld.

title: Chori Chori Chupke Chupke
desc: Raj and Priya, a married couple, hire Madhubala, a prostitute, as the surrogate mother of their child. Trouble brews when Madhubala falls in love with Raj and insists on keeping the child.

title: Skanda
desc: A skilled martial artist's life changes when a secret agency recruits him to stop terrorists. He faces a dangerous mission that will test his abilities and courage beyond anything he is known.

title: Bhoot Bangla
desc: After inheriting a cursed ancestral palace in Mangalpur, Arjun hosts his sister Meera's wedding there. The decision unleashes a violent supernatural force tied to their family history.

title: Aravind Sametha Veera Raghava
desc: A young man sets out to avenge his father's death but soon realises that violence is not the key to his salvation. His life changes when he meets another man, who helps him rediscover himself.

title: Jayantabhai Ki Luv Story
desc: A street thug and a young woman from different backgrounds fall in love with each other. They plan to get married, but her father disapproves.

title: Batti Gul Meter Chalu
desc: Interlinked in a love triangle, three childhood friends tumble into a courtroom drama when a printing press owned by one of them receives an inflated electricity bill.

title: Chennai vs China
desc: Aravind is a descendant of a martial arts expert, Bodhidharma. He must revive the fighting skills to stop Dong Lee, who comes to India to wage a biological war.

title: Akhanda
desc: When the nefarious Varadarajulu plans to attack Murali Krishna, an ardent devotee of Lord Shiva, Akhanda leaves no stone unturned to defeat the evil.

title: Prem Ratan Dhan Payo
desc: Prem, who looks like Prince Yuvraj Vijay Singh, replaces him just before Vijay is to be crowned king. Although Vijay is engaged to Princess Maithili, she falls in love with Prem.

title: Loveyatri
desc: Sushrut who runs a Garba academy falls in love with a beautiful NRI, Michelle, but her father creates a rift between the two. However, Sushrut is determined to win her back.

title: Koi ... Mil Gaya
desc: A young man with special needs is influenced by his father's scientific work. He encounters an alien who grants him extraordinary abilities and transforms his life.

title: Snake
desc: A young farm girl, ensnared by a sinister stranger's lies, must wield the truth to rescue her family from impending danger.
